composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. creative_direction: Create a tortoise automaton with an unmarked circular silver shell. Avoid numbers, needles, or directional letters on the shell; use concentric metal panels only. Soft warm light reveals the metal curvature against a muted golden background, with no extra equipment. Use polished metal and ceramic miniature. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
